WordsSettings

Lookup card

In the card, the word hints and the subtitles. Press P anywhere to switch. When off, the card blurs it until you click it (self-test).
Highlights words in your list by status, like the subtitles. Also in the toolbar menu.

Voice

Google and Azure play through a smooth fade, so words end cleanly. The system voice can end with a click; that comes from the operating system and can't be changed.
Google's voice has two speeds: normal, and slow (for "slow").
A free Azure Speech resource (F0) reads 500,000 characters a month. Paste "KEY 1" from the resource's "Keys and Endpoint" page; "Check key" finds its region for you.

at 720p; scales with the player

Gemini (optional)

Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Used only when you ask: "Transcribe with Gemini" in the 中 panel for videos without Chinese captions (once per video; the result is kept), and "Write example sentences" in the card for words without any. On the free tier Google may use requests to improve its models.
Check the key to list the models it can use. A "flash" model is fast and has the most free quota.
